disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码（宿主侧与浏览器侧）是否读取或导出凭据、密钥、SSH 私钥、云凭证等敏感信息，未检出任何此类访问：宿主侧为空实现，浏览器侧只有界面按钮逻辑，不接触文件系统。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code (host side and browser side) for reading or exporting credentials, secrets, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, and other sensitive information; no such access was detected: the host side is an empty implementation, and the browser side only contains UI button logic and does not touch the filesystem.

checked_items.zh: 检查了配置与文档是否残留硬编码密钥或令牌，未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked configuration and documentation for leftover hardcoded keys or tokens; none detected.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取凭据文件或敏感目录的代码路径：插件不接触任何文件系统，无凭据读取面，未检出。
evidence.en: No code path that reads credential files or sensitive directories was found: the plugin does not touch any filesystem, has no credential-reading surface; not detected.

checked_items.zh: 审查了插件注入模型上下文的全部文本面：没有注册任何工具、没有注入系统提示段落、没有模型面指令文件；界面按钮提示仅为功能说明文字，无指令覆写、无诱导安装、无凭证诱导措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all text surfaces the plugin injects into the model context: no tools are registered, no system prompt paragraphs are injected, and no model-facing instruction files exist; the UI button tooltip is only functional description text, with no instruction overrides, no installation inducement, and no credential-phishing wording.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 README 与安装文档是否存在伪装系统消息或远程指令加载文案，未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked README and installation documentation for disguised system messages or remote instruction-loading text; none detected.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具、未注入系统提示，无工具描述投毒面，未检出。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any tools or inject system prompts; there is no tool-description poisoning surface; not detected.

evidence.zh: 插件没有任何面向模型的工具文本或会话指令，不存在通过提示词诱导安装或改配置的载体。
evidence.en: The plugin has no model-facing tool text or session instructions; there is no vector to induce installation or configuration changes through prompts.

evidence.zh: 未挂接任何模型输入改写事件，插件不触碰每轮领取的用户消息。
evidence.en: No model input rewriting events are hooked; the plugin does not touch the per-round user messages.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与配置的动态执行与命令执行能力（动态函数、子进程、远程脚本下载执行、安装钩子、代码混淆）：宿主为空实现，浏览器侧仅用官方模块加载器装载界面按钮，均未检出。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configuration for dynamic execution and command execution capabilities (dynamic functions, subprocesses, remote script download-and-execute, install hooks, code obfuscation): the host is an empty implementation, and the browser side only uses the official module loader to mount the UI button; none detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单是否存在安装或构建钩子，无；检查了源码树是否存在 git 钩子、CI 流程、容器配置等执行载体，无。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest for install or build hooks: none; checked the source tree for execution vectors such as git hooks, CI pipelines, and container configurations: none.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置只含一条插入条目（标识与名称），无任何可执行脚本标量，未检出。
evidence.en: The patch config contains only one insertion entry (ID and name), with no executable script scalars; not detected.

evidence.zh: 未调用任何把模型代码注入宿主执行的能力，未检出。
evidence.en: No capability that injects model code into host execution is invoked; not detected.

evidence.zh: 无安装钩子、无树内执行载体，安装过程不执行任何代码；唯一相关卫生问题是文档推荐浮动分支安装，已归入供应链维度记录。
evidence.en: No install hooks, no in-tree execution vectors; the installation process does not execute any code; the only related hygiene issue is the documentation recommending floating-branch installation, which has been recorded under the supply chain dimension.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器侧加载；对客户端代码做了专项检查，未检出键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据写入等敏感行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares browser-side loading; a dedicated check of the client code was performed, and no sensitive behaviors such as keyboard listening, clipboard reading, or credential writing were detected.

evidence.zh: 未注册任何子代理提供方，不存在把轮次委派到进程外产品的路径。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider is registered; there is no path to delegate rounds to an out-of-process product.

evidence.zh: 未注册后台任务、定时任务或持久目标，无安装后持续存活的行为。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled tasks, or persistent goals are registered; there is no post-install persistent-resident behavior.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部网络出口：浏览器侧仅调用官方命令执行链（在宿主进程内），无网络请求、无实时通道、无自定义地址外联、无隧道或编码外发，未检出任何出站域名。
checked_items.en: Checked all network egress: the browser side only invokes the official command execution chain (within the host process); no network requests, no real-time channels, no outbound connections to custom addresses, no tunneling or encoded exfiltration; no outbound domains were detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了文档与配置中是否存在外发通道配置，无。
checked_items.en: Checked documentation and configuration for outbound channel settings: none.

evidence.zh: 未挂接模型请求路由事件、未注册自定义模型适配器、未接管模型请求错误重试，无运行时路由劫持面。
evidence.en: No model request routing events are hooked, no custom model adapters are registered, and model request error retries are not taken over; there is no runtime routing-hijack surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单：仅声明官方宿主运行时作为对等依赖，无 git 依赖、无可疑同名依赖，未检出依赖混淆或仿冒包名。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest: only the official host runtime is declared as a peer dependency; no git dependencies, no suspicious same-name dependencies; no dependency confusion or spoofed package names detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子与版本基线：无安装脚本；本次为首次审计，无历史版本可比。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks and version baseline: no install scripts; this is the first audit, so there is no historical version to compare against.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装文档推荐的安装方式：README 与安装指南推荐以 main 分支方式安装（未钉死具体版本），存在浮动引用卫生问题，已记发现。
checked_items.en: Checked the installation method recommended in the installation docs: the README and installation guide recommend installing via the main branch (without pinning a specific version), which is a floating-reference hygiene issue; recorded as a finding.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无禁用安全项的写法，无环境变量降权，未检出。
evidence.en: The patch config does not modify security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; there is no pattern to disable security items, no environment variable privilege reduction; not detected.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何事件监听，不存在可截断审批链的高优先级监听器。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no event listeners; there is no high-priority listener that could truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线，无法比对升级自动激活或能力突变。
evidence.en: First audit; no previous version baseline exists, so upgrade auto-activation or capability mutations cannot be compared.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写任何服务的注入或拦截配置，未检出。
evidence.en: The patch config does not modify any service's injection or interception configuration; not detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动网络服务或监听端口：未检出——纯前端按钮，无任何服务端行为。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a network service or listens on ports: not detected—it is a pure frontend button with no server-side behavior.

checked_items.zh: 对插件运行时的能力面（网络、命令、文件、模型面）与声明做了对账：插件行为仅为在输入框注入按钮并执行官方 plan 命令，与纯界面插件声明一致。
checked_items.en: Reconciled the plugin's runtime capability surface (network, command, file, model) against its declarations: the plugin's only behaviors are injecting a button into the input box and executing the official plan command, consistent with the declared pure-UI plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 web 服务、不监听端口，无本机无认证调用面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports; there is no local unauthenticated call surface.

title.zh: 安装文档推荐以浮动分支安装（未钉住具体版本）
title.en: The installation docs recommend installing from a floating branch (without pinning a specific version)

description.zh:
README.md:31、README.zh-CN.md:31、docs/install.md:6 三处安装文档均推荐 `dsh plugin --profile web add "github:a903067276-rgb/dsh-plan-switch#main"`，以 main 分支（浮动引用）安装而非钉住具体提交。插件自身的依赖清单没有 git 依赖（仅对等依赖官方宿主运行时），问题只存在于安装文档面向用户的推荐路径。

dsh 生态建议 git 安装钉住具体提交，否则作者后续任何推送都会静默改变更新或重装后实际运行的代码，绕过对已审计版本的信任锚点。
description.en:
README.md:31, README.zh-CN.md:31, and docs/install.md:6 all recommend `dsh plugin --profile web add "github:a903067276-rgb/dsh-plan-switch#main"`, installing from the main branch (floating reference) rather than pinning a specific commit. The plugin's own dependency manifest has no git dependencies (only a peer dependency on the official host runtime); the issue exists only in the user-facing recommendation path in the installation docs.

The dsh ecosystem recommends pinning a specific commit for git installations; otherwise, any future push by the author will silently change the code actually run after update or reinstall, bypassing the trust anchor of the audited version.

evidence.zh: README.md:31 与 README.zh-CN.md:31、docs/install.md:6 逐字相同：`dsh plugin --profile web add "github:a903067276-rgb/dsh-plan-switch#main"`。
evidence.en: README.md:31, README.zh-CN.md:31, and docs/install.md:6 are verbatim identical: `dsh plugin --profile web add "github:a903067276-rgb/dsh-plan-switch#main"`.

impact.zh:
后果：按文档安装或更新的用户会跟随 main 分支漂移，作者此后任何推送（含仓库被顶替后的内容）都会在重装或更新时静默生效，脱离本次审计的提交快照。

触发条件：用户照 README 或安装指南执行安装命令即触发，无需其它条件——文档即默认推荐路径。

定级依据：LOW——快照内无任何恶意证据，属供应链卫生问题；危害需假设 main 分支未来内容发生变化，且仅影响不自行钉版本的用户，未达更高门槛。
impact.en:
Consequence: Users who install or update per the docs will drift with the main branch; any future push by the author (including content after repository takeover) will silently take effect upon reinstall or update, deviating from the audited commit snapshot.

Trigger condition: The issue is triggered as soon as a user runs the install command per the README or installation guide; no other condition is needed—the docs are the default recommended path.

Rating basis: LOW—there is no malicious evidence in the snapshot; it is a supply chain hygiene issue. The harm assumes future content changes on the main branch and only affects users who do not pin versions themselves; it does not meet a higher threshold.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验：清单声明合法、名称无仿冒，作者为非官方社区账号，已在范围说明中注明。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification: manifest declarations are legitimate, no name spoofing; the author is an unofficial community account, as noted in the scope description.

summary.zh: 静态扫描：机械预扫零命中；人工复核源码与配置未检出危险执行、注入、凭据与外联模式。
summary.en: Static scan: zero hits from the mechanical pre-scan; manual review of source code and configuration detected no dangerous execution, injection, credential, or outbound-connection patterns.

summary.zh: 行为分析：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感路径读取、无外联域名。
summary.en: Behavior analysis: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no sensitive-path reads, no outbound domains.

summary.zh: 语义审查：无工具与系统提示注入面；界面文案与文档无诱导措辞，唯一卫生问题为文档推荐浮动分支安装。
summary.en: Semantic review: no tool or system-prompt injection surface; UI copy and documentation contain no inducement wording; the only hygiene issue is the docs recommending floating-branch installation.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this phase.

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无 l4-sandbox 产物）。能力声明无显式清单，按代码实测推断（网络/命令/文件均不使用，仅调用官方 plan 命令）。作者为非官方社区账号，账号历史与可信度无法核验（无 GitHub 元数据）。README 与安装指南推荐以 main 浮动分支安装，已记 LOW 发现。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no l4-sandbox artifact). The capability declaration has no explicit manifest; it is inferred from actual code inspection (no network, command, or file usage; only the official plan command is invoked). The author is an unofficial community account; account history and trustworthiness cannot be verified (no GitHub metadata). The README and installation guide recommend installing from the main floating branch; recorded as a LOW finding.
